messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up 3 CFO asked for a short playbook we can use to accelerate partner credit issuance for marketplace private offers that need to go live inside an NDA window (often 30-45 days). Can we sketch constraints + approvals?

sarah-sales: +1. We get a lot of requests where SI or cloud reseller needs a short-term credit to help customer proof-of-value. Approval bottleneck is the finance signoff and legal NDA timing.

simon-finance: We can pre-authorize up to $25k in credits for validated partners with signed SOW + simple NDA, but need an automated flag in the offer metadata so we can track burn.

jon-eng: From infra side, we need to know if the offer will route to Dedicated vs Hosted. That affects predicted spend. For short windows we often recommend capped burst credits rather than open-ended discounts.

liz-partner-ops: Suggest a two-track flow: (1) Rapid path: pre-approved partner cohort + template NDA -> up to X credits, auto-issue. (2) Standard: full review for larger commitments.

kevin-hardware: For hardware bundle deals we sometimes need to frontload credits to make TCO look compelling. Can the credit be scoped to Marketplace SKU + Dedicated add-on?

ann-bizdev: We should also include a clause for joint announcement cadence 3 partners expect co-marketing if they hit certain usage thresholds within the window.

maria-partnerships: Drafting a minimal policy suggestion here. Thoughts on values and gating?

simon-finance: Proposal: rapid path = up to $25k credits, 45-day window, single-use per partner per quarter, requires: signed NDA (templated), p.o. or SOW reference, partner registration in portal. Anything above routed to partnerships + finance review.

liz-partner-ops: +1. Add a field on the private offer payload: `partner_accel=true` so tracking and expiry are automatic. I can patch marketplace listing metadata to surface expiration.

jon-eng: Example payload snippet we can support in the API:
```json
{
  "offer_id": "PO-12345",
  "partner": "SI-Capgemini",
  "partner_accel": true,
  "credit_amount": 20000,
  "expiry_ts": 1768889999,
  "target_skus": ["rwd-hosted-std","rwd-dedicated-small"]
}
```
This lets runtime route and caps billing.

kevin-hardware: Works for bundling. We just need clear SKU mapping so credits apply only to service tokens, not hardware invoices.

ann-bizdev: Marketing / joint announcement note: require partner to sign simple co-marketing NDA and provide logo/quote by expiry + a minimum utilization threshold (e.g., 50% of credit used) to qualify.

sarah-sales: Operational ask: can partner-ops expose a short checklist in the partner portal (NDA signed, PO attached, use-case brief)? That would speed up reviews.

liz-partner-ops: Yep. I'll add a checklist UI + webhook to finance when checklist completed.

maria-partnerships: Risks? Fraud/credit gaming? Simon?

simon-finance: We'll add a burn-rate monitor and an anomaly detector. If >80% of credits consumed within 3 days with unusual SKU mix, auto-pause and flag for review.

jon-eng: We'll emit tracing tags so support and SRE can see accelerated offers in the logs (route, model variant, region).

maria-partnerships: Nice. Action items: liz to implement `partner_accel` metadata + portal checklist; simon to draft finance pre-authorization rules; jon to add runtime tagging and SKU policy; ann to draft co-marketing cadence; sarah to compile partner eligibility. Can we aim for a ready-to-share playbook doc by EOW?

liz-partner-ops: I'll start the metadata PR today. ETA Wed. :rocket: 

kevin-hardware: I'll sync with HW channel about enforced non-coverage of physical hardware costs.

simon-finance: Draft rules by Tue COB.

jon-eng: I'll add the payload support and tag emission 3 PR by Thu.

ann-bizdev: I'll put a draft announcement checklist in confluence and share.

maria-partnerships: Great 3 if anyone needs a sample template NDA or SOW wording, ping legal or me. I'll consolidate into a one-pager playbook and drop it here.

bot-deploy: Reminder: marketplace metadata schema v2 will roll out next week; fields added must be backward compatible. See https://confluence.internal/schema/marketplace-v2

maria-partnerships: Thanks @bot-deploy 3 liz, please coordinate schema changes with eng.

liz-partner-ops: Will do.

sarah-sales: Thanks all. This will fix a lot of slow cycles we've been seeing. :+1:

maria-partnerships: Closing loop 3 I added an initial checklist draft to the partners folder. I'll ping again when the consolidated playbook is ready.
